most_different.content_a: Mount Everest is the highest peak above sea level on Earth. Its height is officially recognized as 8,848.86 meters (29,031.7 feet) as of the most recent measurement in 2020, which was a joint effort by Nepal and China. This measurement includes the snow cap at the summit. The height of Mount Everest can vary slightly due to geological factors and changes in the snow and ice cover.
most_different.content_b: Mount Everest, the highest peak above sea level, stands at 8,848.86 meters (29,031.7 feet) tall. This measurement was updated in December 2020 by China and Nepal, reflecting the most accurate assessment of its height to date.
